description: A comprehensive, categorized list of occupation titles with rated occupation-to-employment-type availability for graduate tracer surveys, employment forms, career systems, and labor-market datasets.
locale_note: Includes internationally recognized occupations and titles commonly used in the Philippines.
data_model_note: Employment type is related to but not determined solely by occupation. Ratings indicate common availability in the Philippine labor market and should guide filtering, not serve as a legal determination.

employment_types.name: Regular or Permanent
employment_types.description: Ongoing employment without a predetermined end date, typically with the rights and benefits granted to regular or permanent personnel.

employment_types.name: Temporary
employment_types.description: Employment for a limited period, temporary vacancy, seasonal need, or other short-term arrangement.

employment_types.name: Casual
employment_types.description: Employment that is occasional, intermittent, or not part of the employer's regular permanent staffing arrangement.

employment_types.name: Contractual
employment_types.description: Employment or engagement governed by a contract for a fixed term, specific project, defined service, or agreed deliverable.

employment_types.name: Self-employed
employment_types.description: Work performed through one's own business, professional practice, trade, farm, freelance activity, or other income-generating activity without being an employee of another organization.

availability_levels.label: Common
availability_levels.description: A routine or widely used arrangement for the occupation.

availability_levels.label: Possible
availability_levels.description: A valid arrangement that occurs but is not necessarily dominant.

availability_levels.label: Uncommon
availability_levels.description: An unusual arrangement; keep available through expanded search.

availability_levels.label: Not applicable
availability_levels.description: The arrangement is structurally incompatible or generally inappropriate for the occupation as titled.

filtering_config.condition: occupation.employment_type_availability[selected_employment_type_id] must be common or possible for the initial filtered list

mapping_methodology.basis: Rule-based survey guidance using occupation category, work setting, independent-practice potential, project or seasonal patterns, and role-specific overrides.
mapping_methodology.legal_notice: This is a survey usability mapping, not a legal classification of a worker. Actual employment status depends on the contract, facts of the working relationship, employer sector, and applicable law.
mapping_methodology.review_recommendation: Keep an Occupation Not Listed option and allow administrators to revise ratings using collected survey evidence.

reference_sources.name: Labor Code of the Philippines, Article 295 on regular and casual employment
